resources.string: This phone is being set up for monitoring. While it is on, the person responsible for this phone can see its location, which apps are used, incoming messages and call history, and may view this screen. A notice stays in your status bar the whole time monitoring is active. Enter the pairing code you were given and confirm you agree.
I understand this phone will be monitored, and I agree to it.
This phone is already paired and being monitored.
Monitoring is on. You can leave this screen.
Grant usage access (needed for app-usage monitoring)
Grant notification access (needed for message monitoring)
Grant accessibility access (read chats as they are opened)
Reads messages from the screen in messaging apps when a chat is open, so they can be monitored with consent.
This phone\'s screen can be viewed and controlled.
Lets the parent lock this phone remotely. Unlocking the PIN also needs this phone set up as a managed device.
Location, apps, messages, calls and screen may be monitored.
A permanent reminder that this phone is being monitored.
